correctness.rationale: The algebra is a central quotient of the published 13-dimensional example, so Jacobi is inherited. Exact rational elimination of necessary Novikov identities leaves 50 free variables but forces [R_2,R_3]_(11,2)=-1/4, contradicting commuting right multiplications. The public verification script reconstructs the full calculation and checks each intermediate rank.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. The 2008 primary source gives the 13-dimensional three-step nilpotent counterexample, and later accessible material continues to cite that construction. Targeted searches found no 12-dimensional three-step nilpotent counterexample, no matching central quotient, and no overlapping SCOPE record. An unindexed or differently phrased smaller example remains a residual risk.

value.rationale: The result lowers the explicit dimension of a four-generated three-step nilpotent Lie algebra known not to admit a Novikov structure from 13 to 12, and gives a compact exact obstruction concentrated in one right-commutator entry.
